title: kaji relocate pushes a re-target only after the target's prechecks pass
goal: A re-target signed while a coordinator runs never fences it before the target's promote has passed its local check and the B-121-T02 probe
acceptance: A committed test fails first: B runs epoch 3 through D, the owner relocates to C at 4, C's promote is refused, and B is still acting
kaji relocate no longer fences the running main on its own; the decision doc and the relocation guide say how the records reach the target
The owner agrees the change to kaji relocate before work starts
Owner agreed 2026-11-24: P1; relocate pushes nothing until the target passes its prechecks
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
escalation: Changes what kaji relocate does: the owner agrees before work starts
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
